title: Prepare and publish REL-v0.8.0

scope.authorization_source: Owner decisions in the 2026-08-03 conversation: formally register the already integrated work-item binding policy in v0.8.0, begin the governed publication workflow, complete the owner-controlled tag handoff, and after hosted publication authorize changing only the v0.8.0 GitHub Release body while preserving tag, Release identity, and all four assets.
out_of_scope: creating, moving, deleting, replacing, or pushing Git tags
mutating the v0.8.0 Release identity, tag association, name, draft or prerelease state, or assets; only the explicitly authorized body-only correction is permitted after source finalization
DEVWF-001, INIT-001, STD-001, OBS-001, historical archive migration, or legacy identifier retirement

steps: Register WIBIND-001 and reconcile the exact three-item v0.8.0 backlog set.
Instantiate all six release-publication templates without copying a previous release instance.
Build and validate deterministic candidate packages, exact v0.7.0 upgrade, authored release documents, and the candidate lifecycle contract.
Obtain independent read-only candidate verification and reconcile any finding before integration.
Commit, push, open a ready pull request, pass required checks, and merge through the pull-request-only main policy.
Run the sanctioned current-main pre-tag command and stop before any tag or publication action.

After the owner-created tag and successful hosted publication, validate immutable evidence, reconcile registries, render the published body from integrated source, perform the authorized body-only correction, and close the workflow.
